arbitrary_comment: Container to hold arbitrary extra arguments to downstream programs.
array_start_comment: When creating array jobs on a cluster, start at this number (for easier sorting).
basedir_comment: Choose the base direectory in which this instance of cyoa will run.
bash_functions_comment: Place to put the invocation of the module command.
bash_source_comment: Shell fragment used to run environment modules.
cluster_comment: The type of compute cluster or undefined.
compress_comment: Compress outputs with xz upon completion (use a string to choose another compressor).
delimiter_comment: Default set of delimiters to separate stuff.
directories_comment: Repeat the current command over this list of directories.
input_name_comment: A place to put arbitrary input names if one wishes.
interactive_comment: Define if the current invocation is interactive.
language_comment: Use this when creating the current job.
library_comment: Specify the library to search against, or guess it.
libtype_comment: Type of sequence library against which to compare: genome/rRNA/contaminants/CDS/etc.
loghost_comment: Send logs to this host in slurm/torque/etc.
module_string_comment: The command invoked when loading specific environment modules.
modules_comment: Load these modules for the current command.
option_file_comment: Use this file to read options in an asynchronous job.
output_base_comment: Base directory for all outputs from cwd().
preprocess_dir_comment: Assume this directory when iterating over multiple samples.
search_string_comment: Use this when doing quick searches of logs etc.
shebang_comment: How to find the shell when creating jobs.
species_comment: Use this species name when appropriate, often for getting fasta/gff/etc files.
submission_args_comment: FIXME: Split these to separate files for various cluster types. Arguments when submitting jobs to a cluster, defaulting to slurm.
submission_sbatch_depends_comment: Use this for slurm dependency chains.
submission_torque_depends_comment: String to pass when creating a dependency chain on a cluster (slurm by default).
submission_torque_dependsarray_comment: String to pass when creating dependency chains with arrays.
submission_path_comment: Specify a tool to submit jobs to a cluster.
suffixes_comment: Delimited set of suffixes to remove when invoking basename.
task_comment: Some tools have different options depending on the task, define that here.
type_comment: Miscellaneous option when various types of job may be performed.
version_comment: Choose a specific version of ... whatever ...
